decision_summary: Self-review confirms v0.6.30 closes the structural Framework Learning loop without treating change volume or verifier success as learning.
rationale: Visionary: contradictory calibration evidence can now reach the framework itself. Builder: schema, bidirectional refs, lifecycle rules, readiness logic, positive regression, and 13 negative cases cover the end-to-end path. Guardian: the committed example stays proposed and example-only; implemented readiness requires empirical provenance, accepted governance, artifacts, validation, rollback criteria, and resolved triggers; semantic benefit remains unproven.
recommendation: Proceed to public-residue, schema, diff, and organization verification before final review.
